notes.title: Version 1.0.1.1 Patch Notes & Dev Letter about English Version
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.1.1 Update Notes
【Experience Optimizations】
[olist]
Optimized teleport point logic on certain maps, affecting cross-map NPC behaviors (e.g., NPC pathing after splitting up in dungeons).

Improved loading logic for map resources, ensuring smoother transitions.

Enhanced overall architecture to boost compilation speed and game performance.

Refined multi-language adaptation with added detailed translations (to be synchronized with global multi-language support later).
[/olist]
【Bug Fixes】
[olist]
Fixed intermittent issues when selling multiple stacked items simultaneously.

Resolved abnormal NPC positioning under extreme conditions.

Addressed limited weapon variety for random NPCs; adjustments will gradually restore intended levels.

Fine-tuned story illustrations for certain characters to enhance visual impact.

General fixes for minor bugs under edge cases.
[/olist]
【New Features】
[olist]
Added automatic Meridian Activation when companions breakthrough cultivation realms.

Increased captive character capacity in inventory, allowing players to hold more captives.
[/olist]
【Major Workshop Update】
New Action Nodes with execution timing options enable freer and more precise task system customization. By combining nodes and conditions, players can design mission mechanics mirroring the game's native system.

I. New Action Nodes:

NPC Affinity Adjustment: "Set" or "Increase/Decrease" NPC affinity toward the player.

Relationship Settings: Modify relationships between NPCs and players.

Pop-up Notifications: Deliver native-style task prompts with full text editing.

II. New Branch Node Conditions:

NPC Affinity Check: Trigger subsequent storylines/branches based on NPC affinity.

Relationship Check: Unlock plots using NPC-player relationship criteria.

Trigger Node Status Check: Dynamically guides task flow based on player-designed conditions.

III. New Trigger Node Features:

Default Dialogues & Repeatable Triggers: Assign fixed dialogues when branch conditions are unmet.

IV. New Branch Node Type:

Multi-choice Dialogue: Create options that trigger unique plots/commands per selection.

V. Other Workshop Optimizations
[olist]
Improved UI adaptability for branch nodes, enhancing readability.

Streamlined node duplication to reduce operational complexity.

Stabilized node port connection logic.

Enhanced stability when loading MOD configurations in the editor.

Fixed default illustration display errors for MOD NPCs under edge cases.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.16 Patch Notes & Dev Letter about English Version
notes.notes:
Official Version V1.0.0.16 Update Content:

【Experience Optimizations】
[olist]
 Added 64 new sets of story character portraits. The portrait selection interface now supports long-press for quick switching.
 Added support for leaving the Assassin Organization.
 Messenger Pigeons now display the real-time coordinates of the relevant NPC.
 Added a secondary confirmation dialogue for Martial Arts Sparring with story NPCs.
 The in-game system menu now supports opening the local log directory. This automatically opens when reporting issues.

 Factions now support the relocation of their headquarters. Adjusted the logic for alliance disbandment.
 Optimized the performance of the Faction Member interface to prevent lag when there are many members.
 Added the display of Faction Level to the Faction Relationship list.
 The Faction interface now responds to the ESC key to exit.
 Faction members dispatched for expeditions can no longer take on labor jobs.
[/olist]

【Bug Fixes】
[olist]
 Fixed an issue preventing combat under the Spanish regional setting.
 Fixed the logic for switching and saving between two sets of key bindings.

 Fixed an issue where Willpower dropped to 0 for story NPCs after being captured.
 Fixed an issue where many random NPCs knew sword, blade, and spear martial arts but not fist techniques, yet had no weapon equipped.
 Fixed an issue where resource gathering always yielded only 1 unit.
 Fixed the patrol route for Capital City Constables.

 Fixed an issue where Faction Prisoners lacked the "Recruit as House Servant" dialogue option.
 Fixed abnormal dialogue for Faction Prisoners after they become house servants.

 Corrected the Light Kung Fu/Internal Kung Fu martial arts and Friendship Lists for Sandbox story NPCs.
 Corrected dialogue content and options for Sandbox story NPCs.
 Fixed an issue where Sandbox story NPCs did not revert to their original portraits after their Mod portraits were deprecated.

 Fixed the issue in the [Eternal Ambition] quest where Song Hongyu was not moved.
 Fixed the incorrect corpse coordinates for Tianxiaren in [Shattered Heavens].
 Modified the quest guidance text for [Unification of Heluo], adding a prompt indicating the need to complete [The Nation's Secret].
 Fixed a typo in [The Trail of the False Hero].
 Fixed an issue where some saves with [Enlightened Resolve · II] guidance could not accept the quest.
 Corrected the coordinates for Tuoba Xiao and Shen Wuxia in Sandbox mode.

 Fixed configuration errors for some martial arts and common moves.
 Fixed an issue where non-Sect NPCs were using Sect martial arts techniques.
[/olist]

Since most of the bugs for the official version have been largely addressed, subsequent updates won't be as frequent as the initial bug-fixing phase right after launch. We will return to the previous schedule of one major update per month or one every two months.
Finally, thank you all for your support. 

Wishing everyone have a good  Dragon Boat Festival! ^_^

[hr][/hr]
Dear Players, 
We want to be fully transparent about the delays in releasing the English version of Path of Kung Fu. The main challenge comes from our early development approach—significant amount of the game’s text were hardcoded into the game systems rather than being set up for easy localization. 

What This Means for Development: 
1.A massive amount of content must be manually extracted. 
2.Each system (quests, UI, items) requires separate refactoring. 
3.Localization now involves restructuring parts of the core code. 

We're simultaneously working on finalizing game content and optimizing player experience. It`s taking more time than our expect,and we are actively working on it.

A Heartfelt Thank You 
We’ve received many kind offers from players willing to help with translation. We’re deeply moved by your passion for Path of Kung Fu! Unfortunately, due to the technical hurdles mentioned above, we can’t yet provide text files for community translation. Once the extraction is complete, we’ll explore ways to involve you in polishing the localization. 
Your patience and support mean the world to us. We’ll keep you updated on our progress, and we’re committed to delivering a version that meets your expectations. 

With gratitude, 
Path of Kung Fu Team

notes.title: Path of Kung Fu-Upcoming release-English version
notes.notes:
We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude for your continuous support of "Path of Kung Fu" .It has been six months since the Early Access (EA) version of the game was launched. Over these months, we have rolled out nearly 30 updates, including 3 major version upgrades. After careful consideration by our development team, we have decided to transition from EA to the full release by the end of April. Alongside this, we will also be launching an English version of the game. Once again, thank you all for your attention and support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361680/_/

Welcome to join our Discord channel to communicate and exchange game content with the developers.

notes.title: V0.7.0.0-Update notice
notes.notes:

notes.title: Developer Plan 1: Early Access Release Plan
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Since we first mentioned our plans for an Early Access (EA) release, many players have asked us questions like, "What is EA?" and "Why choose this method?" Today, we’d like to share our thoughts with you.

What is Early Access?

For those familiar with indie games, EA might not be a new term. According to Steam’s official definition, EA is: "A tool that allows the community to experience the game before its official release and gives customers the understanding that the product is ‘unfinished’ but has a playable state with plans for continued development."

In simpler terms, EA is when a game is not fully completed but already has playable content. It is released in this state using the Early Access model.

Why use this approach?

Steam explains that EA helps "bring the community into the development process and provides the developer with funding to complete the game." This perfectly fits our situation.

A Beneficial Cycle

Players who have been in our community from the start will notice that the current version of the game is vastly different from the early versions. Initially, the combat difficulty, controls, and UI were very "rough" (some might say user-unfriendly). This stemmed from our early "closed-door" development approach. Daojian Jianghu Lu is also our team’s first indie game, and we quickly realized this wasn’t the best method.

Once we opened the demo, the first wave of players joined our chat groups and provided invaluable and practical suggestions. The game has steadily improved through this positive feedback loop. We learned that engaging with the player community keeps the game on the right development path, creating a win-win for both developers and players. (PS: Our three active chat groups are full as I write this, with players who have earned top activity badges, proving we’ve been listening to your feedback.)

While this is a bold project for our first game (in terms of development costs), Daojian Jianghu Lu is still an indie game, not a AAA title. We mention this not to excuse any shortcomings but to acknowledge that we still have a long way to go. Rather than letting expectations skyrocket while we "promise more and more," we’d rather put the game in your hands now so we can all continue building this wuxia dream together.

Practical Considerations

We’ve often mentioned the content included in the EA version—700,000 characters of narrative, 24 martial arts styles, 12 light movement techniques, 17 internal arts, 3 story-driven sects, and many more open-world features (baby raising, companion and servant development, etc.). These account for about 55% of the full release, which is expected to launch in Q3 2025.

However, our current development costs have reached the limit of what we can handle. Our loyal fans know that our lead developer, Laomeng, has taken on loans and mortgages to push the game to this point. As this is our first game, it was a very bold decision. Using Early Access will help us gather the funding needed to complete the game.

What content can you expect in the EA version?

It seems we can't avoid this lengthy explanation. The EA version includes:

10 large maps
700,000 characters of narrative
24 martial arts styles
12 light movement techniques
17 internal arts
3 story-driven sects
Open-world features like factions, child-rearing, companion and servant development, brothel gameplay, martial arts schools, bounty hunting, prison break, and more NPC interactions.
This content covers about 55% of the full version. If you find these descriptions a bit abstract, our demo will remain available for you to experience firsthand. You can try it and then decide if the content aligns with your expectations.

We emphasize content details to ensure players have a clear understanding of what the EA version offers.

The EA version focuses mainly on story and combat, with less open-world sandbox gameplay. If you're mainly interested in the open-world features, we recommend waiting for the full release.

Post-EA Update Plan We’ll provide a detailed update plan after the EA release.

notes.notes:
Greetings, heroes of the martial world!

We hope you've all been well.

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the hiatus in our news updates. We've been diligently addressing some challenges during this time, and today, we would like to respond to your questions.

Due to some uncontrollable circumstances with our previous publisher, we have amicably ended that partnership. We are now pleased to announce that we have signed with a new publisher, and the Early Access (EA) version of the game is officially set for release on September 19, 2024.

We deeply appreciate the concern and support from all of you during this period. 
Although the game's release has been delayed from the original schedule, increasing our development costs, we have used this time to further optimize the game. We are working hard to deliver the best experience to you as soon as possible. Thank you once again for your support.

In this EA version, you'll be able to experience:


 Approximately 10 large maps
 700,000 characters (in Chinese) of storyline
 24 martial arts sets
 12 lightness skills
 12 internal skills
 Additionally, we will introduce 3 story-driven sects, open-world factions, child-rearing and development, companion development, servant development, brothel gameplay, martial arts halls, the Three Talents Book, bounty hunting and prison escapes, as well as more interactive gameplay with open-world NPCs, and much more.
